searchText: sorry i'm not keeping up with this, is regenesis actually on a roadmap to be deployed or is it still just a proposal? This sounds like getting at stateless ethereum through the side door. <@!332923501079953409> As far as I know, it's a little of both. It seems like a rather promising stateless-lite and isn't fleshed out enough for anyone to know that it definitely works, but I get the impression that it's where most of the energy is currently going. <@!332923501079953409> Once we get our stuff together, we'll start to do necessary backtesting (similar to what was done for Stateless Ethereum) to see how attractive (or not) ReGenesis may be Ideally, I would like ReGenesis experimental node to live in a separate repo and use Turbo-geth as a library, we are doing similar kinds of code movements already for similar purposes that means that experiments do not need to be embedded, and hopefully it will increase participation Yeah, that makes a lot of sense.
